name: TETRIS® THE GRAND MASTER 4 -ABSOLUTE EYE-
description:
“TETRIS® THE GRAND MASTER 4 -ABSOLUTE EYE-” offers a fast-paced and highly technical Tetris experience, true to the series. Take on new challenges with modes such as ASUKA and SHIRANUI.

Beginner-friendly modes are also included, allowing players of all skill levels to learn, improve, and replay with ease.
